title: Lukas Ude – Corporate Identity
description: A personal brand system between nature, craft and modern systems: logo, colour, typography, image language and applications.

thumbnail.alt: Lukas Ude logo system board: primary logo on dark and light, vertical version, icon, favicon and applications

body: The identity is built on one idea: Cinematic Heritage × Modern Systems. A tree grows from flowing water; its branches turn into connection nodes and a rising chart. Nature, ideas and growth in one mark.

The system stays deliberately restrained: monochrome logo use, a vertical separator, generous clear space. Colour comes from nature – obsidian, ivory, British green, forest and tobacco – with brass as a rare accent (55% black, 30% ivory, 10% natural tones, 5% brass).

Typography pairs an editorial serif (Cormorant Garamond) with a precise sans-serif (Manrope). The image language follows six principles: cinematic, not glossy; authentic, not staged; warm practical light; deep shadows and texture; nature and technology; no neon-AI clichés.
